# US-AUTH-01 — Patient Registration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Name**                | Patient Registration                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Description**         | As a visitor, I want to register as a patient by providing my personal, identification, contact, health, and account information so that I can securely access SaludVital's patient services.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The registration form must be accessible to unauthenticated visitors and display all labels, instructions, and validation feedback in Spanish.<br>2. The form must work on mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop screens and support keyboard navigation.<br>3. First name and last name are required, may contain no more than 50 characters each, and may contain Unicode letters, combining marks, spaces, hyphens, and apostrophes only. The server must trim leading and trailing whitespace, collapse repeated whitespace, and reject unsupported characters without silently removing them.<br>4. Phone number is required, must use a supported format, and may contain no more than 15 characters. Duplicate phone numbers are allowed.<br>5. Date of birth is required, must be a valid calendar date, and must not be later than the current date.<br>6. Document type is required and must be one of the supported values: `CC` or `CE`.<br>7. Document number is required, may contain no more than 15 characters, and must satisfy the validation rules for its document type.<br>8. The system must prevent duplicate patient accounts with the same document type and document number, including concurrent registration attempts.<br>9. Department and municipality are required. The municipality must belong to the selected department, and the relationship must be validated by the backend.<br>10. Changing the selected department must clear the municipality selection.<br>11. Residential address is optional and may contain no more than 150 characters.<br>12. Blood type is optional and, when provided, must be one of: `A+`, `A-`, `B+`, `B-`, `AB+`, `AB-`, `O+`, or `O-`.<br>13. Allergies and existing medical conditions are optional and may contain no more than 255 characters each.<br>14. Account email is required, must have a valid format, must be unique, and may contain no more than 320 characters.<br>15. A new password must contain 10–50 characters, at least one uppercase letter, at least three lowercase letters, one digit, and one special character.<br>16. A new password must not exceed 72 bytes when encoded as UTF-8, to prevent bcrypt input truncation.<br>17. Password confirmation is required and must exactly match the password.<br>18. Passwords must be securely hashed. Plain-text passwords and password confirmations must never be stored or logged.<br>19. The server must assign the Patient role; the client must not be able to select or elevate an account role.<br>20. The system must send an email verification message and require account verification before the patient can access protected patient services.<br>21. Registration validation and database errors must not leave an incomplete account.<br>22. Invalid submissions must show understandable feedback and must not create an account.<br>23. The login form must accept account emails up to 320 characters and passwords up to 50 characters and 72 UTF-8 bytes. Patients with an existing password outside those limits must use password recovery to set a supported password.<br>24. Automated tests must cover field validation, duplicate prevention, password rules, email verification setup, secure role assignment, authorization, and failure behavior. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A # US-AUTH-03 — Password Recovery

| **Identifier**          | **US-AUTH-03**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Name**                | Password Recovery                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Description**         | As a registered patient, I want to recover my password through my registered email address so that I can regain access to my SaludVital account if I forget my password.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. An unauthenticated user can open the password recovery form from the login page.<br>2. The recovery form and all user-facing messages must be in Spanish and usable with a keyboard on mobile, tablet, and desktop.<br>3. The user can submit an email address with a valid format and a maximum length of 320 characters.<br>4. The response must not reveal whether the submitted email address belongs to a registered account.<br>5. For an eligible account, the system must enqueue and send a recovery email using the existing email delivery infrastructure.<br>6. The recovery link must contain a cryptographically secure, time-limited, single-use token.<br>7. The system must not store raw recovery tokens when a hashed-token approach is supported. Tokens must never be logged or exposed in user-facing errors.<br>8. The system must reject missing, malformed, expired, or previously used tokens.<br>9. The user can open a valid recovery link and access a form to enter and confirm a new password.<br>10. A new password must contain 10–50 characters, at least one uppercase letter, at least three lowercase letters, one digit, and one special character.<br>11. A new password must not exceed 72 bytes when encoded as UTF-8, to prevent bcrypt input truncation.<br>12. Password confirmation is required and must exactly match the new password.<br>13. The new password must be hashed before storage. Plain-text passwords must never be stored or logged.<br>14. A successful password reset must invalidate the recovery token and follow the existing session-security behavior.<br>15. A patient whose existing password exceeds 50 characters or 72 UTF-8 bytes must be able to use password recovery to set a password within the supported limits before signing in.<br>16. Email delivery failures must be handled safely without exposing credentials, tokens, or whether an account exists.<br>17. The system must apply appropriate rate limiting to recovery requests.<br>18. The interface must provide understandable Spanish feedback for successful requests, invalid or expired links, validation failures, and delivery errors.<br>19. Automated tests must cover authorization, valid and invalid inputs, email privacy, token generation and expiration, token reuse, password validation, successful reset, and failure behavior.<br>20. Recovery request, confirmation, and reset screens must follow the approved responsive SaludVital visual design.<br>21. The recovery request and confirmation screens must reserve replaceable illustration areas until final artwork is supplied.<br>22. The recovery screens must reuse the approved login illustration and show a WhatsApp contact action only when a valid contact is configured. |     | **Mockups** | Supplied password recovery request, link-sent, and reset references; reserved illustration slots remain replaceable. |

# US-AUTH-03 — Password Recovery

| **Identifier**          | **US-AUTH-03**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Password Recovery                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Description**         | As a registered user who has forgotten my password, I want to recover access to my account so that I can sign in again securely.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The login page must provide an option to initiate password recovery.<br>2. The system must allow the user to submit the account identifier required by the recovery process.<br>3. The system must display a generic confirmation that does not disclose whether an account exists for the submitted identifier.<br>4. The system must use a secure, time-limited recovery mechanism to authorize a password change.<br>5. Recovery credentials must be unique, unpredictable, and invalidated after use or expiration.<br>6. The system must reject expired, invalid, or previously used recovery credentials.<br>7. The new password must satisfy the application's password requirements.<br>8. The system must request confirmation of the new password and reject the change if the values do not match.<br>9. The system must store the new password securely and must never store it as plain text.<br>10. The system must confirm when the password has been changed successfully.<br>11. The system must not change the password when any required validation fails.<br>12. After recovery, the user must authenticate using the new password.<br>13. The system must handle recovery failures without revealing sensitive account information.<br>14. Recovery request, confirmation, and reset screens must follow the approved responsive SaludVital visual design.<br>15. The recovery request and confirmation screens must reserve replaceable illustration areas until final artwork is supplied.<br>16. The recovery screens must reuse the approved login illustration and show a WhatsApp contact action only when a valid contact is configured. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied password recovery request, link-sent, and reset references; reserved illustration slots remain replaceable.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

# US-AUTH-04 — Secure User Logout

| **Identifier**          | **US-AUTH-04**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Secure User Logout                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated Patient, Doctor, or Administrator, I want to log out securely or have my session close automatically after inactivity so that my account and personal information remain protected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The system must provide an explicit logout option to authenticated users.<br>2. When the user selects logout, the system must end the authenticated session according to the application's session-management policy.<br>3. The system must clear the client's authentication state and remove locally stored authentication credentials where applicable.<br>4. After logout, the system must redirect the user to the login page or another designated public page.<br>5. The system must prevent access to protected pages and resources after logout unless the user authenticates again.<br>6. The system must automatically log out the user after **3 consecutive minutes (180 seconds) without qualifying activity**.<br>7. The inactivity timeout must apply equally to Patients, Doctors, and Administrators.<br>8. Qualifying user activity must reset the inactivity timer according to the defined session policy.<br>9. Background polling, automatic refreshes, and other system-generated requests must not count as user activity unless explicitly defined by the session policy.<br>10. When the inactivity limit is reached, the system must clear the client's authentication state and redirect the user to the login page.<br>11. A user must not be able to regain access to protected resources simply by navigating backward in the browser after logout or session expiration.<br>12. Logout and automatic expiration must not expose authentication credentials or sensitive personal information.<br>13. The system must provide a clear message when the session expires due to inactivity. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## US-AUTH-05 — Role-Based Access Control

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-AUTH-05                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Name**                | Role-Based Access Control                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **User Story**          | As an authenticated user, I want the system to enforce permissions according to my assigned role so that I can access only the features and information authorized for me.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The system must recognize the roles Patient, Doctor, and Administrator.<br>2. Each protected feature must require authentication before access is granted.<br>3. The system must verify the user's permissions on the server for every protected operation.<br>4. Patients must not access doctor-only or administrator-only operations unless explicitly authorized by a separate permission.<br>5. Doctors must not access administrator-only operations unless explicitly authorized by a separate permission.<br>6. Administrators must access only the operations permitted by the administrator role and the application's authorization rules.<br>7. Hiding a menu item or button in the interface must not be considered sufficient authorization.<br>8. If an authenticated user attempts an unauthorized operation, the system must deny the request without exposing protected data.<br>9. The system must return or display an appropriate unauthorized or forbidden response according to whether authentication or permission is missing.<br>10. Changing client-side values, URLs, or submitted role information must not grant additional permissions.<br>11. The system must apply the same authorization rules to browser requests and direct requests to protected endpoints. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## US-AUTH-06 — Authentication Session and Token Validation

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-AUTH-06                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Name**                | Authentication Session and Token Validation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **User Story**          | As a user of SaludVital, I want the system to validate my authentication session continuously so that expired, invalid, or inactive sessions cannot be used to access protected resources.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The system must validate authentication credentials or tokens before granting access to protected server resources.<br>2. The system must reject expired, invalid, malformed, or incorrectly signed authentication tokens.<br>3. The system must enforce the **3-minute inactivity limit** for Patients, Doctors, and Administrators.<br>4. The inactivity policy must be enforced consistently by the client and the server; client-side timers alone must not be sufficient.<br>5. Qualifying user activity must update the session's last-activity state through the approved session-management mechanism.<br>6. The system must ensure that automatic requests or background activity do not unintentionally keep an inactive session alive.<br>7. When 3 minutes of inactivity have elapsed, the server must reject further protected requests from that session.<br>8. The authentication mechanism must enforce expiration in a way that remains consistent with the inactivity policy, including any required token renewal or server-side session tracking.<br>9. After expiration, the client must clear its authentication state and redirect the user to the login page.<br>10. Requests made with an expired or invalid session must not return protected data or perform protected actions.<br>11. A user must authenticate again before accessing protected resources after session expiration.<br>12. The system must not trust client-provided role, expiration, or last-activity values without appropriate server-side validation.<br>13. Authentication failures must be handled without exposing token contents, secrets, or sensitive implementation details.<br>14. The system must preserve consistent authentication behavior across the Patient, Doctor, and Administrator areas. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
