## US-AUTH-07 — Patient Dashboard Access

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-AUTH-07                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Name**                | Patient Dashboard Access                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **User Story**          | As an authenticated Patient, I want to access my patient dashboard so that I can use the services available to my account.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. After successful login, a Patient must be redirected to the patient dashboard.<br>2. The dashboard must be accessible only to authenticated users with the Patient role.<br>3. The system must display the patient-facing interface and the features authorized for that role.<br>4. The dashboard must not expose another patient's private information.<br>5. If a Patient attempts to access a doctor-only or administrator-only resource, the system must deny access.<br>6. If the Patient's session is logged out or expires, the system must deny further access to protected dashboard resources.<br>7. After session expiration, the system must redirect the Patient to the login page.<br>8. The dashboard must display an appropriate error or feedback message when required information cannot be loaded.<br>9. Reloading or directly opening a protected dashboard URL must not bypass authentication or authorization. |

# Authentication — User Stories

## US-AUTH-09 — Manage Authenticated Sessions

| **Identifier**          | **US-AUTH-09**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Name**                | Manage Authenticated Sessions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated SaludVital user, I want my session to be handled securely and expire after the configured period of inactivity so that my account remains protected when I stop using the application.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. After successful authentication, the application establishes a session using the existing secure authentication mechanism.<br>2. The session identifies the authenticated user and their database-assigned role.<br>3. Protected routes require a valid authenticated session.<br>4. The application enforces role-based access to protected routes.<br>5. The session expires after 180 seconds of inactivity, according to the project's current session policy.<br>6. Activity refreshes the session only through the existing authenticated activity mechanism.<br>7. Logging out invalidates the active server-side session and clears the authentication cookie.<br>8. Session cookies use the security settings configured by the application.<br>9. Authentication tokens and session identifiers are not exposed in user-facing messages or logs.<br>10. Automated tests cover session creation, protected-route access, role checks, inactivity expiration, and logout. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A — Backend authentication and session management behavior.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## US-AUTH-11 — Protect Login Against Consecutive Failed Attempts

| **Identifier**          | **US-AUTH-11**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Protect Login Against Consecutive Failed Attempts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Description**         | As a registered SaludVital user, I want repeated incorrect password attempts to trigger a temporary login lock so that my account is protected from password guessing while successful sign-ins remain unaffected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The application counts consecutive incorrect-password attempts for an existing account using persistent, concurrency-safe storage.<br>2. After five consecutive failed password attempts, the account is locked for 15 minutes and further login attempts are rejected.<br>3. When the lock expires, the application resets the failed-attempt counter before processing another attempt.<br>4. Failed-attempt state is cleared only after a valid login session has been established. Logging out does not change it.<br>5. Malformed requests, correct passwords, and correct passwords for accounts requiring email verification do not count as failed password attempts.<br>6. Before the lock threshold, invalid-credential responses remain generic.<br>7. Once an account is locked, the login page displays a clear message and the remaining lock time.<br>8. While locked, the email, password, password-visibility, and submit controls are disabled. They are re-enabled when the countdown expires.<br>9. The server rejects login attempts throughout the lock, even if a user bypasses the disabled controls.<br>10. Separate IP-based protection limits repeated login requests without counting successful sign-ins against its failure allowance. When this limit is reached, the page shows the remaining time and disables the login controls.<br>11. Counters and lock timestamps are updated atomically to prevent concurrent requests from bypassing the threshold.<br>12. Passwords, authentication tokens, and unnecessary account data are never logged or returned. The locked email is not echoed.<br>13. Existing password hashing, email verification, role-based redirects, secure session handling, and inactivity expiration remain functional.<br>14. Automated tests cover the threshold, lock expiration, successful-login reset, logout, unknown accounts, concurrent attempts, disabled controls, countdown expiration, and error handling.<br>15. A reversible database migration is added when persistent lockout fields are required. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A — Login security and temporary account lockout behavior.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

# US-AUTH-12 — Automatically Remove Unverified Patient Registrations

| **Identifier**          | **US-AUTH-12**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Automatically Remove Unverified Patient Registrations                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Description**         | As a person who registers for SaludVital, I want an unverified registration to be removed automatically after 30 minutes so that abandoned accounts do not retain personal information indefinitely and the email can be used again.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The retention period starts at the account's persisted registration time and defaults to 30 minutes.<br>2. A cleanup process removes only patient accounts that remain unverified after the retention period.<br>3. The cleanup rechecks verification and account age inside a database transaction before deleting anything.<br>4. Verified accounts are never removed by this process.<br>5. The cleanup removes the patient profile and registration-verification email outbox jobs only when safe and necessary for referential integrity.<br>6. The process skips accounts that have dependent appointment, clinical, notification, audit, WhatsApp, or other business records; it does not delete those records.<br>7. In-flight verification-email jobs cannot send a link for an account already eligible for cleanup.<br>8. Cleanup is idempotent, bounded per run, and safe when multiple application instances run it.<br>9. Failures are logged without exposing passwords, tokens, email contents, or unnecessary personal data.<br>10. The cleanup is started by the existing application lifecycle and does not require a separate service or dependency.<br>11. Add unit and integration tests for eligible deletion, verified-account preservation, dependency protection, concurrent verification/cleanup, retry behavior, and scheduler execution.<br>12. No credentials, passwords, verification tokens, audit history, or clinical records are stored in cleanup logs. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A — Backend automated cleanup of expired unverified patient registrations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

| **Name**                | Book Medical Appointment | **User Story**          | As an authenticated Patient, I want to book a medical appointment by selecting a specialty, doctor, date, and available time slot so that I can receive medical care at a convenient time.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The system must allow the patient to select an active medical specialty.<br>2. The system must display eligible doctors associated with the selected specialty.<br>3. The patient must be able to select an appointment date based on the doctor's schedule and applicable exceptions.<br>4. Available appointment slots must use 30-minute intervals.<br>5. The system must exclude past dates, past time slots, occupied slots, blocked slots, and unavailable schedule periods.<br>6. The appointment start time must be at least 30 minutes after the booking request is submitted, and the server must enforce this minimum.<br>7. Changing the specialty must clear incompatible doctor, date, and time selections.<br>8. Before booking, the system must display a summary of the specialty, doctor, date, and time.<br>9. The patient must explicitly confirm the booking before the appointment is created.<br>10. The backend must revalidate availability and prevent conflicting or duplicate bookings, including concurrent requests.<br>11. If a slot becomes unavailable, the system must reject the booking and display a clear Spanish message.<br>12. After successful booking, the system must display confirmation and make the appointment available in My Appointments.<br>13. The interface must adapt to mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop screens.<br>14. Only authenticated patients may create appointments for their own accounts.<br>15. A patient may have no more than two non-cancelled appointments on the same calendar day in Bogotá time, and no more than one non-cancelled appointment per specialty on that day.<br>16. Pediatrics appointments are available only to patients aged 0–17 on the appointment's local calendar date in Bogotá time. The backend must calculate age from the persisted date of birth and enforce this rule during both availability lookup and booking. Patients aged 18 or older on the appointment date cannot book Pediatrics.<br>17. Specialty search must match active specialties by name and description without case or diacritic sensitivity. Leading, trailing, and repeated whitespace must be normalized, and results must continue to come from persisted active specialties. |

## US-PAT-02 — View and Filter My Appointments

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-PAT-02                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Name**                | View and Filter My Appointments                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **User Story**          | As an authenticated Patient, I want to view and filter my appointments by status so that I can track upcoming appointments and review their history.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The system must display only appointments belonging to the authenticated patient.<br>2. Each appointment must display its specialty, doctor, date, time, and current persisted status.<br>3. The patient must be able to view confirmed appointments.<br>4. The patient must be able to identify appointments that have been rescheduled and see their current scheduled date and time.<br>5. The patient must be able to view cancelled appointments.<br>6. The patient must be able to review attended appointments and their preserved history.<br>7. The interface must provide filters or tabs for Confirmed, Attended, and Cancelled appointments; it must not provide a dedicated In Progress filter.<br>8. The appointments summary must not include a separate In Progress count.<br>9. Persisted In Progress appointments must remain unchanged and may appear in the unfiltered list with their actual status.<br>10. The system must preserve appointment history when an appointment is cancelled or rescheduled.<br>11. The system must display an appropriate empty state when no appointments match the selected filter.<br>12. The patient must be able to open appointment details in an accessible, centered modal when authorized.<br>13. The interface must adapt appointment cards or tables to smaller screens without horizontal overflow.<br>14. The backend must enforce patient ownership for every appointment query.<br>15. For each confirmed future appointment with fewer than three successful reschedules, the patient must have a shortcut in the appointment list that opens the rescheduling page with that appointment selected. The shortcut must not appear for ineligible appointments.<br>16. Appointment list and detail views must display only fields supported by persisted appointment data. A clinic location must not be displayed unless it is associated with a persisted location. |

# US-PAT-03 — Reschedule Medical Appointment

| Identifier              | US-PAT-03 | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Reschedule Medical Appointment                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated patient, I want to reschedule an eligible appointment so that I can choose another available time when my plans change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only the authenticated patient who owns the appointment can reschedule it.<br>2. Only confirmed appointments can be rescheduled.<br>3. A confirmed appointment is eligible for a patient reschedule request only when its current scheduled start is at least 24 hours after the request. Requests submitted with less than 24 hours remaining must be rejected by the backend.<br>4. Each appointment can be rescheduled a maximum of three times.<br>5. The patient must keep the same doctor when selecting a new date and time.<br>6. Replacement slots must follow the assigned doctor's availability and start at least five hours after the rescheduling request is submitted.<br>7. The system must reject a slot that is unavailable, conflicts with another appointment, or violates the patient's booking limits.<br>8. When the change is submitted, the server must revalidate ownership, confirmed status, the 24-hour eligibility window for the original appointment, the three-reschedule limit, the five-hour minimum for the replacement slot, and slot availability.<br>9. Concurrent requests must not book the same doctor slot.<br>10. Updating the appointment and recording its reschedule history must succeed or fail as one atomic operation.<br>11. The history must preserve the previous and new appointment date and time.<br>12. Before saving, the patient must see a confirmation dialog with the current and proposed appointment times.<br>13. The patient must be able to cancel the confirmation without changing the appointment.<br>14. The system must show success or failure feedback in Spanish in a centered modal.<br>15. After a successful reschedule, the form must clear its selected appointment, date, and time.<br>16. From the dashboard, selecting “Reprogramar cita” for an eligible upcoming appointment must open the form with that appointment selected.<br>17. If the dashboard appointment is not eligible, the system must explain why in a modal without navigating to the rescheduling form.<br>18. The interface must work on mobile without horizontal overflow and use the official SaludVital palette.<br>19. Pediatrics reschedules are available only when the patient is aged 0–17 on the replacement appointment's local calendar date in Bogotá time. The backend must calculate age from the persisted date of birth and enforce this rule during availability lookup and rescheduling. Patients aged 18 or older on the replacement date cannot reschedule to Pediatrics.<br>20. The eligible appointment list and the selected-appointment summary must not display a clinic location unless it is associated with persisted appointment data. |

# US-PAT-04 — Cancel Medical Appointment

## Acceptance Criteria

| Identifier              | US-PAT-04                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Cancel Medical Appointment                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated Patient, I want to cancel an eligible medical appointment so that I can release the reserved time when I can no longer attend.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The system must display the cancellation action only for confirmed appointments scheduled at least 24 hours in the future.<br>2. The system must clearly explain that cancellations require at least 24 hours’ notice.<br>3. The patient must confirm the cancellation before the system processes it.<br>4. The backend must use the authenticated patient identity and must not trust a patient identifier supplied by the client.<br>5. The backend must verify appointment ownership, current status, eligibility, and the 24-hour cancellation deadline.<br>6. The system must reject cancellation requests made less than 24 hours before the appointment.<br>7. The system must reject cancellation of appointments that are not confirmed or are not owned by the authenticated patient.<br>8. After successful cancellation, the appointment status must become `Cancelled`.<br>9. The appointment record and its relevant history must be preserved.<br>10. The cancelled time slot must become available according to the existing booking rules.<br>11. The system must display a clear Spanish success message after cancellation.<br>12. If cancellation fails, the system must display a clear Spanish error message and must not report success.<br>13. The cancellation flow and appointment list must work on mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop screens without horizontal overflow.<br>14. The backend must enforce cancellation rules even when a request bypasses the user interface. |

accurate.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

The patient must be able to update their first and last names, email address, phone number, residential address, department, and municipality.<br>4. The patient must be able to update their blood type, allergies, and existing medical conditions.<br>5. The patient must be able to add, update, and remove their emergency-contact information.<br>6. The patient's date of birth, document type, and document number must be visible but read-only in the patient profile.<br>7. The backend must reject patient profile requests that attempt to change the date of birth, document type, or document number, including requests made directly to the API.<br>8. Changes to the date of birth or document information must be handled through an authorized administrative process.<br>9. The system must not trust a patient or user identifier supplied by the client to select which profile to update.<br>10. The backend must validate submitted values, including required fields, formats, lengths, dates, phone numbers, blood types, and department-municipality combinations.<br>11. The system must enforce email uniqueness when the patient changes their email address and require verification of the new address.<br>12. The system must preserve stored information when an update fails and must display understandable Spanish-language validation feedback.<br>13. The system must confirm successful profile updates in Spanish and display the saved information.<br>14. The patient must be able to view, upload, and remove their profile photo; the backend must validate the image format, file content, and size.<br>15. The backend must enforce authentication, the Patient role, and profile ownership for profile updates and photo operations.<br>16. Patients must not be able to change their account role, account status, password, email-verification status, or profile ownership through the patient profile.<br>17. The interface must be accessible and responsive on mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop screens without horizontal overflow.<br>18. The interface must use the official SaludVital palette: #123B73, #168DE2, #13B8B0, #36A96B, and #FFFFFF. |
