# US-PAT-07 — Configure Notification Preferences

| Identifier              | US-PAT-07                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Configure Notification Preferences                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated patient, I want to configure notification channels and their contact destinations so that supported communications can use the channels and contact details I choose.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The patient can view only their own saved notification preferences and destinations.<br>2. The interface provides independent switches for SMS, WhatsApp, and email.<br>3. SMS is enabled by default when the patient has no saved channel preferences.<br>4. At least one channel must remain active.<br>5. The patient can configure separate phone numbers for SMS and WhatsApp.<br>6. The patient can configure an email address for notifications, separate from the account login email.<br>7. Updating notification destinations does not change the patient’s profile phone or account login email.<br>8. Appointment reminders, rescheduling updates, and cancellations appear as active, read-only notification types.<br>9. Appointment confirmations and promotions do not appear as configurable notification types.<br>10. Selecting **Save Changes** opens a centered confirmation modal summarizing the selected channels and destinations.<br>11. Canceling the confirmation leaves saved settings unchanged.<br>12. Confirming the save persists the selected channels and destinations for the authenticated patient.<br>13. The backend validates submitted channels, phone numbers, email address, and patient ownership.<br>14. Invalid updates are rejected without partially changing saved settings.<br>15. Successful and failed saves display clear feedback in Spanish in a centered modal.<br>16. The interface is accessible and responsive on mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop.<br>17. The interface explains that saving preferences does not guarantee message delivery when a channel provider is unavailable or unconfigured. |

# US-PAT-08 — Automate Appointment Notifications

| Identifier              | US-PAT-08                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Automate Appointment Notifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Description**         | As a patient with notification preferences saved, I want appointment reminders and appointment changes sent through the channels I enabled so that I can stay informed without checking the portal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. A confirmed appointment scheduled more than 24 hours in advance queues a reminder for 24 hours before its start.<br>2. An appointment booked less than 24 hours in advance does not receive a late reminder.<br>3. Rescheduling sends an update for the new appointment time and replaces any pending reminder for the previous time.<br>4. Canceling an appointment sends a cancellation notice and cancels its pending reminders.<br>5. Notifications are sent only through channels enabled by the patient and to the corresponding saved destinations.<br>6. Provider configuration or approved-template errors are recorded as failed and are not repeatedly retried.<br>7. Transient provider errors are retried according to the configured policy and eventually reach a terminal status.<br>8. Notification history records the event, channel, provider message or operation ID when available, attempt count, and status.<br>9. The scheduler does not send messages while the global delivery switch is disabled.<br>10. Automated tests cover scheduling, preference filtering, stale reminder cancellation, provider errors, and retry behavior.<br>11. Messages do not include appointment reasons, diagnoses, or other clinical details. |

# US-PAT-09 — Send Immediate Appointment Confirmations

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-PAT-09                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Name**                | Send Immediate Appointment Confirmations                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Description**         | As a patient with notification preferences saved, I want to receive an immediate confirmation after an appointment is successfully created, so that I can verify its date, time, specialty, and doctor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. A confirmation job is created only after a new appointment is successfully persisted; failed or rolled-back bookings enqueue no confirmation.<br>2. The confirmation uses the patient's currently enabled notification channels and saved destinations. No channel is added or enabled by this feature.<br>3. Confirmation is not added as a separately configurable notification type in the patient preference interface.<br>4. Resend and Inalambria use the existing provider adapters, retry policy, and notification persistence.<br>5. Meta WhatsApp confirmation is sent only with a configured approved template compatible with the required variables; absent or invalid configuration is reported as a safe provider/configuration failure.<br>6. Each appointment confirmation is idempotent and is not duplicated by retries or repeated enqueue requests.<br>7. The notification includes the appointment date, time, specialty, and doctor when available, and excludes clinical reasons, diagnoses, and other unnecessary sensitive data.<br>8. Provider acceptance is never represented as final delivery; final WhatsApp delivery state is recorded only from Meta callbacks.<br>9. Provider failures do not undo a successfully booked appointment and are recorded using the existing safe error handling.<br>10. The global notification-delivery switch continues to prevent all external sending when disabled.<br>11. Patient-facing confirmation and relevant history labels are in Spanish.<br>12. Automated tests cover booking transaction success/failure, enabled channel routing, disabled channels, idempotency, missing provider/template configuration, retries, and safe message content.<br>13. No new tables or dependencies are introduced unless existing persistence cannot support this behavior and a separate approval is obtained. |
| **Dependencies**        | Meta Cloud API requires an owner-approved confirmation template configured in the deployment environment. Resend sender-domain verification and Inalambria account enablement remain provider-side prerequisites.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

                                                                                                                                   |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want a clean dashboard showing my key daily metrics, today’s agenda, and next appointment, so that I can quickly understand my workday and open the relevant authorized view.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. After signing in, a doctor lands on their dashboard and sees a Spanish greeting and today’s appointment count.<br>2. The dashboard shows persisted counts for today’s appointments, active patients, consultations completed during the current week, and average consultation duration.<br>3. The active-patient count is based on unique patients with at least one completed consultation with this doctor in the previous rolling 12 months; each patient is counted once.<br>4. The **Today’s appointments** metric card is clickable across its full surface and opens the authenticated doctor’s agenda.<br>5. The **Active patients** metric card is clickable across its full surface and opens only the doctor’s authorized patient list.<br>6. The **Consultations this week** and **Average duration** metric cards show their values without report or statistics buttons and are not presented as links.<br>7. A **Today’s appointments** section remains visible and lists only appointments assigned to the authenticated doctor, with appointment time, patient name, reason when available, status, and permitted action.<br>8. A **Next appointment** section remains visible when the doctor has a future appointment and shows only the minimum information needed to identify and prepare for it.<br>9. The dashboard does not expose patient phone numbers, email addresses, or clinical history in its summary cards.<br>10. Eligible appointments expose the permitted consultation action; the backend remains responsible for authorization and consultation rules.<br>11. The WhatsApp help/contact panel and **Quick Access** section are absent from the dashboard.<br>12. Metric cards that navigate are keyboard accessible, have visible focus states, and have clear accessible names.<br>13. The dashboard is responsive on mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop; metrics and appointment sections remain readable and usable.<br>14. Empty states are shown when there are no appointments today or no upcoming appointment.<br>15. All displayed metrics and appointments are scoped to the authenticated doctor; sample mockup values are not hardcoded. |

| Identifier              | US-DOC-02                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to view and find appointments assigned to me by date range, status, patient name, or document number, so that I can organize my schedule and locate the appointment I need.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated users with the Doctor role can access the appointment page and its data.<br>2. The doctor can view only appointments assigned to their authenticated account; client-supplied identifiers cannot change this scope.<br>3. Each appointment displays its date and time, patient name, patient photo when available or initials when no photo exists, appointment reason or type when available, and current status.<br>4. The page displays appointment totals for All, Confirmed, Attended, and Cancelled appointments, with accurate counts for the authenticated doctor.<br>5. The doctor can filter appointments by start date and end date. The system validates the date range and rejects invalid ranges.<br>6. The doctor can filter by Confirmed, Attended, or Cancelled status. “In Progress” is not offered as a filter.<br>7. The doctor can search by patient name or document number, and results update as the doctor types.<br>8. Search and filters apply only to the authenticated doctor’s appointments. Searching does not grant access to the patient’s clinical history.<br>9. The appointment list supports pagination and displays the current page and result range.<br>10. The page displays clear Spanish feedback when appointments are found, when no appointments match the search or filters, or when the doctor has no appointments.<br>11. The page is keyboard accessible and responsive on mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop.<br>12. This story does not start or complete consultations; those actions belong to their corresponding user stories. |

Before starting the consultation, the backend must validate the doctor's identity, the appointment assignment, and the appointment status.<br>9. The interface must be accessible and responsive on mobile phones, tablets, and computers. |

# US-DOC-04 — Record and Complete a Medical Consultation

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-04**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Name**                | Record and Complete a Medical Consultation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to record the clinical information from a consultation and complete it so that the patient's medical history stays up to date and the care provided is documented.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only the doctor assigned to the appointment may record or modify the consultation information.<br>2. The system must associate the clinical record with the correct patient, appointment, and doctor.<br>3. The doctor must be able to complete the clinical fields defined by the system for the consultation.<br>4. The system must validate required fields before saving or completing the consultation.<br>5. The doctor must be able to save information for an in-progress consultation without marking it as complete.<br>6. The doctor must be able to complete the consultation once all required validations pass.<br>7. When the consultation is completed, the appointment and consultation statuses must remain consistent.<br>8. The system must preserve saved information and prevent duplicate records for the same visit.<br>9. Save errors must be displayed with clear messages and, whenever possible, without losing the entered data.<br>10. Before storing information, the backend must validate authorization, ownership, and data consistency.<br>11. The interface must be accessible and responsive on mobile phones, tablets, and computers. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/DeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

# US-DOC-05 — Register and Complete a Medical Consultation

| Identifier              | US-DOC-05                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Register and Complete a Medical Consultation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to record, save, and resume a patient's consultation so that I can document the medical care provided and complete the consultation while preserving its clinical information.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The reason for the visit, the patient's current condition, blood pressure, heart rate, temperature, weight, height, and medical evaluation are required to complete the consultation.<br>2. The diagnosis and its notes are optional; the consultation can be completed without a diagnosis.<br>3. Medications, recommendations, and medical orders are optional. If a medication is added, its name, dosage, frequency, and duration are required.<br>4. The doctor must be able to save and retrieve a draft, review the consultation summary, and complete the consultation.<br>5. Upon completion, the consultation and appointment must be updated consistently.<br>6. The consultation start modal must be centered on the screen, and the consultation interface must display the elapsed time since the consultation began.<br>7. The form displays Spanish guidance and field limits consistent with server validation; automated tests cover these constraints. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/DeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## US-DOC-05 Acceptance Criteria Addendum — Issue #261

8. Vital-sign fields display their units, expected format, examples, and technical input limits: blood pressure uses positive two- or three-digit systolic/diastolic values; heart rate is an integer from 1 to 300 lpm; temperature is 25–45 °C with one decimal; weight is 0.1–500 kg with one decimal; and height is 0.1–3 m with two decimals. The backend rejects malformed values, values outside these technical bounds, and unsupported precision; atypical measurements within them remain recordable.
9. For adult patients only, the form may show non-blocking reference warnings for adult resting blood pressure, heart rate, and temperature. The interface explains that ranges vary by patient context and are not a diagnosis. Adult reference values are not applied to minors.
10. The consultation form and backend enforce these text limits: reason 500 characters; patient condition 500; medical evaluation 1,500; diagnosis 200; diagnosis notes 200; medication name 150; dosage, frequency, and duration 100 each; medication instructions 1,000; and recommendations 500.
11. Medical orders remain optional and support up to 30 non-empty orders, each no longer than 300 characters. The browser provides immediate feedback, and the server validates every submitted line.
12. Vital-sign warnings do not block saving drafts or completing the consultation. Existing draft, completion, authorization, and persistence rules remain in force.

## US-DOC-05 Interface Addendum — Issue #263

13. The consultation progress indicator distinguishes the current stage, previously visited stages, and stages that are not yet available. Future stages remain unavailable until reached through the form actions.
14. Step changes announce the current stage to assistive technology and move keyboard focus to the new section heading.
15. Consultation stages remain readable and usable by keyboard on mobile, tablet, and desktop widths without horizontal overflow. Draft save, draft recovery, and completion behavior remain unchanged.

# US-DOC-06 — View Assigned Patients, Appointments, and Clinical History

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-06**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Assigned Patients, Appointments, and Clinical History                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to search patients connected to my assigned appointments and review their appointments and clinical history, so that I can understand the care already provided and prepare for follow-up.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The patient list must contain unique patients related to appointments assigned to the authenticated doctor. Client-supplied doctor IDs must not be allowed to expand access.<br>2. The doctor must be able to search the authorized patient list by name, document number, or phone number. Search results must remain scoped to that doctor.<br>3. Selecting a patient must display that patient's authorized clinical history and appointments without exposing another patient's information.<br>4. The patient detail panel must contain only the **Historial clínico** and **Citas** tabs.<br>5. The patient page must not display the **Registrar paciente**, **Nueva consulta**, **Información**, or **Documentos** actions or sections.<br>6. The appointments tab must show only appointments assigned to the authenticated doctor. The clinical history tab must show completed consultations associated with those appointments.<br>7. The doctor's desktop sidebar and mobile navigation must contain only **Inicio**, **Mis citas**, and **Pacientes**.<br>8. Search, patient selection, empty states, and pagination must provide clear feedback in Spanish and must not unexpectedly clear the selected patient.<br>9. The interface must adapt to mobile phones, tablets, and desktop screens without horizontal overflow and must support keyboard navigation.<br>10. Existing models, associations, authentication, and authorization rules must be reused. Database schema or dependency changes must be made only when a demonstrated need exists. |

# US-DOC-07 — View Daily Doctor Agenda

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-07**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Daily Doctor Agenda                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to view my daily agenda with scheduled appointments and administrator-defined availability, so that I can organize my workday without changing my schedule.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only an authenticated user with the Doctor role can access the agenda.<br>2. The agenda loads appointments assigned exclusively to the authenticated doctor.<br>3. The daily view contains a chronological timeline representing the doctor's working hours.<br>4. Each appointment displays its start time, end time, patient name, status, and reason or consultation type when available.<br>5. Show the patient photograph when available; otherwise use a suitable avatar or initials.<br>6. Display working periods and breaks or schedule exceptions configured by administrators.<br>7. The doctor can navigate to the previous day, next day, a selected date, and today.<br>8. The current date is selected initially using the application's configured timezone rules.<br>9. Appointment and schedule data must come from the backend and database, never hardcoded mockup values.<br>10. Clicking an appointment opens its authorized details using existing functionality where available.<br>11. The doctor cannot create, edit, delete, or block working hours from this screen.<br>12. Hide all schedule configuration buttons.<br>13. Display appropriate loading, empty, and error states in Spanish.<br>14. All endpoints must enforce authorization on the server.<br>15. The interface must match the supplied mockup and be responsive and keyboard accessible. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied doctor daily agenda mockup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

# US-DOC-08 — View Weekly and Monthly Doctor Agenda

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-08**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Weekly and Monthly Doctor Agenda                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to switch between daily, weekly, and monthly agenda views, so that I can review my upcoming appointments and plan my workload.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The agenda offers exactly three view selectors: Día, Semana, and Mes.<br>2. The daily view reuses US-DOC-07.<br>3. The weekly view displays appointments arranged by day and time.<br>4. The monthly view displays a calendar with appointment indicators or counts for each day.<br>5. Selecting an appointment opens its authorized details.<br>6. The doctor can navigate between weeks and months without losing the selected view.<br>7. The selected period and view are visually clear.<br>8. Appointment statuses use consistent visual styles and accessible labels.<br>9. Overlapping appointments, if present in existing data, must be displayed without hiding records.<br>10. Empty dates and periods have clear Spanish messages.<br>11. Data is obtained only from appointments belonging to the authenticated doctor.<br>12. Queries must use bounded date ranges and avoid unnecessary loading of unrelated records.<br>13. Calendar controls must work by keyboard and on touch devices.<br>14. Mobile layouts must remain usable without horizontal overflow.<br>15. The doctor must not be allowed to modify administrator-managed schedules. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied doctor agenda calendar mockup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
