# US-DOC-09 — View Next Appointment and Start Consultation from Agenda

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-09**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Next Appointment and Start Consultation from Agenda                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to see my next appointment from my agenda and start an eligible medical consultation, so that I can attend patients efficiently.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. A card named Próxima cita appears in the agenda.<br>2. The next appointment is calculated from persisted records for the authenticated doctor.<br>3. Show the appointment time, patient name, consultation type, and other minimum authorized information needed to prepare for care.<br>4. Include a Ver todas action that navigates to the existing doctor appointments page.<br>5. Include an Iniciar consulta action only when the existing business rules permit it.<br>6. Reuse the consultation flow and authorization rules from US-DOC-03.<br>7. Do not create duplicate consultation routes, services, or business logic.<br>8. The backend validates doctor identity, appointment ownership, status, and eligibility.<br>9. Prevent starting a consultation for an unauthorized, cancelled, already completed, or otherwise ineligible appointment.<br>10. Prevent duplicate consultations.<br>11. Use existing status transitions and existing consultation functionality.<br>12. If no eligible upcoming appointment exists, display an appropriate empty state.<br>13. Do not expose unnecessary patient personal information in the agenda summary.<br>14. The card and its controls must match the supplied design and work on mobile and desktop.<br>15. Include automated tests for permitted and denied consultation actions. |

# US-DOC-10 — View Doctor Availability by Day, Week, and Month

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-10**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Doctor Availability by Day, Week, and Month                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to review my availability and booked appointment capacity for today, the selected week, and the selected month, so that I can understand my workload according to the schedule configured by administrators.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Display three information cards: Mi disponibilidad de hoy, Mi disponibilidad de la semana, and Mi disponibilidad del mes.<br>2. Read availability from the existing doctor availability records and schedule exceptions.<br>3. Read booked appointments from the existing appointment records.<br>4. Show configured working hours for the selected day or period.<br>5. Show breaks, blocked periods, days off, and other relevant administrator-defined exceptions.<br>6. Display available capacity and booked capacity when the data model supports them.<br>7. Derive appointment capacity from actual usable schedule intervals, the established appointment duration, existing bookings, and applicable exceptions.<br>8. Do not use invented totals or hardcoded examples such as 5 de 8 or 18 de 40.<br>9. Avoid counting blocked periods as available appointment slots.<br>10. Do not count cancelled appointments as occupied slots unless an existing explicit business rule requires it.<br>11. Reuse the application's established availability and appointment services where possible.<br>12. The doctor can view, but cannot modify, create, delete, or block availability.<br>13. Do not display Editar, Configurar horarios, Bloquear horario, or Solicitar ausencia buttons.<br>14. Display appropriate empty states when no schedule has been configured by an administrator.<br>15. All availability queries must be restricted to the authenticated doctor.<br>16. The cards must visually match the supplied mockup and adapt to small screens. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied doctor availability cards mockup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

# Doctor Profile — User Stories

# US-DOC-11 — View Doctor Profile

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-11**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Doctor Profile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to view my personal, professional identification, address, and contact information, so that I can review my registered information in SaludVital.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated users with the Doctor role can access their own doctor profile.<br>2. The page displays the authenticated doctor's photograph, full name, medical specialty, professional registration number, and account status.<br>3. The **Datos personales** section displays first name, last name, document type, document number, professional registration or provisional professional card, medical specialty, email, primary phone number, gender, and date of birth.<br>4. The **Dirección** section displays street address, city, and department.<br>The Contact Information section displays the email, primary phone number, and alternate phone number when available. Verification status is displayed only when the application has a persisted verification result for that contact method. Phone verification status is not displayed while phone verification is unsupported.<br>6. Profile information must come from the backend and database, without hardcoded mockup data.<br>7. The profile contains only the **Información personal** navigation section.<br>8. Do not display the **Información profesional**, **Horarios y disponibilidad**, **Seguridad de la cuenta**, or **Preferencias** tabs.<br>9. Do not display the **Foto y firma** section.<br>10. The page must follow the supplied visual reference as closely as possible.<br>11. The layout must adapt to mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop screens without horizontal overflow.<br>12. Unauthorized users cannot access another doctor's private profile.<br>13. Loading, empty, and error states must provide clear Spanish messages.<br>14. The page must support keyboard navigation and accessible labels. |

# US-DOC-12 — Update Doctor Contact and Address Information

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-12**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

Existing validation rules for Colombian phone numbers and location fields must be reused where applicable.<br>8. The interface displays **Guardar cambios** and **Cancelar** while editing.<br>9. The edit interface must match the approved mockup and remain responsive.<br>16. Automated tests must verify successful updates, invalid input, authorization failures, and persistence. |

# US-DOC-13 — Protect Doctor Identity and Professional Information

| **Identifier**          | **US-DOC-13**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Protect Doctor Identity and Professional Information                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Description**         | As a system administrator, I want doctors' identity and professional registration information to remain protected from self-service changes, so that only authorized administrators can modify these records.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The doctor can view their protected information but cannot modify it.<br>2. The following fields are protected from doctor self-service editing:<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• First name.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Last name.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Document type.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Document number.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Professional registration number or provisional professional card.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Medical specialty.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Email address.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Gender.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;• Date of birth.<br>3. Protected fields are displayed in read-only controls or equivalent non-editable components.<br>4. Protected fields have visually distinguishable but accessible styling.<br>5. Where appropriate, the interface explains: **Este dato solo puede ser modificado por un administrador.**<br>6. The **Editar perfil** action never enables protected fields.<br>7. Backend validation uses an explicit allowlist of permitted doctor-editable fields.<br>8. Direct HTTP requests containing unauthorized field changes must be rejected.<br>9. Requests containing both authorized and unauthorized changes must be rejected atomically without partially persisting those changes.<br>10. The doctor cannot bypass restrictions by modifying JavaScript, Pug-generated HTML, or HTTP request payloads.<br>11. Only administrators with existing authorized permissions may modify protected fields through administrative functionality.<br>12. Existing administrator-managed doctor records and workflows must continue to function.<br>13. Administrator changes must follow existing validation and audit rules.<br>14. Automated tests must verify that every protected field remains unchanged after unauthorized update attempts.<br>15. The implementation must not introduce duplicate profile services or unnecessary database migrations. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied doctor profile mockup with protected read-only fields.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to update my profile photograph, so that my account displays a current professional image without changing my protected personal or professional information.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

The doctor can initiate a photograph update using the camera or edit control in their profile.<br>4. The photograph update uses the existing upload and storage infrastructure where available.<br>5. The backend validates the uploaded file type and maximum permitted size.<br>6. Invalid or unsafe files are rejected with a clear Spanish message.<br>7. The doctor may update only their own photograph.<br>8. Upload endpoints do not permit modification of protected profile fields.<br>9. The interface displays the updated photograph after a successful save.<br>10. The profile photograph appears correctly on desktop and mobile.<br>11. The existing doctor dashboard avatar should reflect the updated photograph where the application already supports it.<br>12. Do not implement professional signature uploading or editing.<br>13. Automated tests verify upload authorization, permitted file types, invalid files, and successful persistence. |

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

| **User Story**          | As an authenticated administrator, I want an overview of SaludVital’s users, appointments, doctors, specialties, recent activity, and delivery alerts so that I can monitor day-to-day platform operations.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated users with the Administrator role can access the dashboard and its data.<br>2. Summary cards show counts from existing records for registered and active users, today’s appointments and completed appointments, active doctors, and pending WhatsApp requests.<br>3. The weekly appointments chart distinguishes scheduled, completed, and cancelled appointments and uses a defined local date range.<br>4. Specialty distribution is calculated from existing appointments and specialties; counts and percentages reconcile with the displayed total.<br>5. Recent activity and system alerts come from existing audit and notification records. The dashboard does not present sample data as real.<br>6. Dashboard responses are bounded and contain only the data the interface needs. They do not expose message content or unnecessary patient information.<br>7. The dashboard follows the supplied desktop and mobile mockups, supports keyboard use, and has no horizontal overflow on phones, tablets, or computers.<br>8. Dates and visible interface text are in Spanish.<br>9. Existing models and dependencies are reused. Schema or dependency changes require a demonstrated need. |

## US-ADM-07 — Activate or Deactivate Doctor

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

| **User Story**          | As an authenticated administrator, I want to activate or deactivate a doctor's account so that I can control the doctor's access and availability according to SaludVital's operational requirements.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The Doctors directory and doctor profile display the current account status consistently.<br>2. Administrators can activate or deactivate a doctor through an explicit action.<br>3. Deactivation requires confirmation that explains the immediate loss of access and the effect on future appointments.<br>4. The backend prevents deactivated accounts from accessing protected functionality.<br>5. Deactivation identifies future confirmed appointments for the doctor and cancels only those eligible appointments; past, in-progress, attended, and already-cancelled appointments remain unchanged.<br>6. Each cancelled appointment retains its history, including the administrator responsible and the cancellation reason.<br>7. Patients affected by cancellations are notified through the existing notification infrastructure and their communication preferences; delivery failures follow the existing retry mechanism.<br>8. The account status, appointment cancellations, appointment history, and audit record are updated consistently in a transaction.<br>9. Reactivation restores account status according to existing authentication requirements and does not recreate cancelled appointments.<br>10. The action and confirmation interface work on desktop, tablet, and mobile screens. |

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-ADM-19                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Name**                | View and Search Doctor Schedules                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **User Story**          | As an authenticated administrator, I want to view and filter doctor schedules so that I can monitor schedule configuration and upcoming exceptions in SaludVital.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access the schedule management page and its protected endpoints.<br>2. The page displays real doctor, availability, and schedule-exception records from the database. The weekly view displays persisted appointments for the selected doctor and week. It must not use mock records or hardcoded statistics.<br>3. Summary cards display:<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;a. **Active doctors:** distinct doctors whose linked user account is active.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;b. **Doctors with a configured schedule:** distinct active doctors with at least one active availability block whose validity overlaps the selected week.<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;c. **Upcoming exceptions:** active schedule exceptions whose time range overlaps the next seven calendar days in the `America/Bogota` timezone.<br>4. The administrator can search doctors by display name or email and filter schedule results by doctor, specialty, schedule status, and week. Schedule status distinguishes a doctor with an active availability block valid during the selected week from one without a valid block. Weeks run Monday through Sunday in `America/Bogota`.<br>5. Search and filters are validated and applied consistently by the backend.<br>6. Summary cards use their documented calculations and do not use hardcoded values. Doctor, specialty, and schedule-status filters affect the results list; the selected week determines the configured-schedule count.<br>7. The page provides loading, empty, and error states.<br>8. Visible interface text, dates, and status labels are in Spanish.<br>9. The interface follows the supplied SaludVital schedule-management desktop and mobile reference.<br>10. The layout is responsive and has no horizontal overflow on mobile devices.<br>11. Controls support keyboard navigation and accessible names and states.<br>12. Existing doctor, availability, exception, appointment, layout, and authorization implementations are reused wherever possible.<br>13. Schema or dependency changes require a demonstrated technical need. This story does not add schedule editing, exception management, or appointment resolution workflows. |

| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to view a doctor's weekly schedule and availability details so that I can understand their working hours, available slots, breaks, blocked periods, and scheduled appointments.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

The administrator must be able to select a doctor and navigate between weeks using the existing schedule data.<br>3. The weekly view must display the configured days and time intervals supported by the current scheduling model.<br>4. The weekly view must distinguish persisted appointments, active available time, and active Unavailable exceptions. It must display an exception’s stored reason when available and must not invent breaks or availability states that are not represented by persisted data.<br>5. The schedule must not present invented appointments, time slots, or availability states.<br>6. Selecting a doctor must display the relevant specialty and configured schedule information supported by the existing data model.<br>7. The view must display configured working days and hours. Appointment duration is a system-wide value of 30 minutes and must be shown as informational; it is not configurable per doctor.<br>8. The system must use the application's established date and timezone conventions.<br>9. The weekly schedule must reflect persisted changes and must not expose unnecessary patient information.<br>10. When no schedule exists, the interface must display an understandable empty state rather than fabricated data.<br>11. Visible labels and date information must be in Spanish.<br>12. The desktop view must follow the supplied weekly-grid reference design. On mobile, the grid must adapt to a readable layout without horizontal overflow.<br>13. Controls must be keyboard accessible, and status differences must not rely on color alone.<br>14. Existing scheduling models, appointment relationships, and services must be reused. |

### US-ADM-21 — Configure Doctor Schedules

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| **Name**                | Configure Doctor Schedules                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to configure a doctor's working days and hours so that SaludVital can calculate when the doctor is available for appointments.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can create or configure doctor schedules.<br>2. The schedule management page must provide a clearly visible action to configure a schedule for an eligible doctor.<br>3. The form must use existing doctor records and support only fields compatible with the current scheduling model.<br>4. The administrator must be able to configure supported working days and working hours. Appointment duration remains the system-wide value of 30 minutes and cannot be configured per doctor.<br>5. The backend must validate required fields, valid time ranges, supported appointment durations, and other existing scheduling constraints.<br>6. The system must reject overlapping availability blocks for the same doctor when their weekdays and validity dates overlap.<br>7. Before saving a schedule that would place future confirmed appointments outside the resulting availability or inside an active Unavailable exception, the system must show those appointments and require explicit confirmation. It must not change the appointments.<br>8. The schedule must be persisted using the existing database architecture and relationships.<br>9. Validation errors must be understandable and must not unnecessarily discard entered information.<br>10. After successful configuration, the schedule must appear in the weekly schedule view and be reflected in relevant availability calculations.<br>11. The operation must not create, cancel, or reschedule appointments unless explicitly required by existing business rules.<br>12. Visible interface text and validation messages must be in Spanish.<br>13. The form must be responsive, keyboard accessible, and consistent with the supplied visual reference.<br>14. Existing models, dependencies, and scheduling workflows must be reused wherever possible. |

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Edit Doctor Schedules                                                                                                                      |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated Administrator, I want to edit, add, or delete time slots in a doctor's schedule so that I can keep their working days and hours up to date and prevent new bookings when they are no longer available.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated Administrators can access schedule editing, deletion, and their corresponding endpoints.<br>2. Each existing time slot provides an edit action that opens a form populated with its current data.<br>3. The Administrator can update the permitted fields and add non-overlapping time slots, including multiple slots on the same day when separated by breaks.<br>4. The Administrator can delete an existing time slot from the effective schedule.<br>5. When a time slot is deleted, it is no longer offered for future appointments; its record and historical references are preserved.<br>6. The backend validates days, effective dates, times, 30-minute limits, and all other existing scheduling constraints.<br>7. The system prevents invalid or conflicting time slots according to the existing rules.<br>8. Before applying an edit or deletion, the system identifies future confirmed appointments that would fall outside the resulting schedule or overlap with an `Unavailable` exception. The Administrator must review the affected appointments and explicitly confirm the change.<br>9. After confirmation, affected future appointments are cancelled using the existing `Cancelled` status.<br>10. Appointments and their historical relationships are preserved. Their records and scheduled times are not deleted, modified, or rescheduled.<br>11. The schedule change, appointment cancellations, history, audit records, and cancellation of pending reminders are processed transactionally using the existing infrastructure.<br>12. Cancellation notifications are queued according to the configured settings and patient preferences. If no notification can be queued, the system informs the Administrator.<br>13. If the transaction fails, the original schedule and affected appointments remain unchanged, and the system displays an understandable error message.<br>14. Schedule changes and deletions are reflected in the schedule view and availability calculations.<br>15. Relevant changes are recorded in the existing audit system.<br>16. All user-facing text, confirmations, and error messages are displayed in Spanish.<br>17. The interface is responsive, keyboard-accessible, and consistent with the reference design.<br>18. Existing scheduling models, relationships, and dependencies are reused. |
