| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to create, view, edit, and deactivate schedule exceptions so that holidays, vacations, personal leave, and non-working days are reflected in doctor availability.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access schedule exception management and its protected endpoints.<br>2. The system must display existing exceptions retrieved from the database without using mock data.<br>3. Administrators must be able to create and edit exceptions using fields supported by the existing data model.<br>4. Exceptions apply to one doctor. Supported exception types are the existing `Unavailable` and `AdditionalAvailability` values. Reasons such as vacation or personal leave must be stored as the exception description, not introduced as new exception types.<br>5. The backend must validate required fields, valid dates, date ranges, and applicable scheduling constraints.<br>6. Before applying a change that may affect appointments, the system must identify and show the affected future confirmed appointments. Deactivating an `AdditionalAvailability` exception with affected appointments must follow the explicit review and cancellation confirmation workflow defined in US-ADM-29.<br>7. Creating or modifying an exception must never silently delete, cancel, or reschedule appointments. Appointments may be cancelled only after the administrator reviews the affected list and explicitly confirms the US-ADM-29 flow.<br>8. Deactivating an `Unavailable` exception, reactivating an exception, creating an exception, or editing an exception must not cancel appointments.<br>9. Exception types and their behavior must follow existing application rules; unsupported types must not be invented.<br>10. Active exceptions must affect availability calculations according to configured business rules. Inactive exceptions must be excluded from the weekly view and availability calculations.<br>11. Administrators must be able to deactivate and reactivate exceptions without deleting them. The system must persist each state change and record it in the existing audit trail.<br>12. Validation errors must be displayed in understandable Spanish without unnecessarily losing entered information.<br>13. The interface must show loading, empty, and error states.<br>14. The interface must be responsive, keyboard accessible, and consistent with the supplied reference design.<br>15. Existing exception models, services, audit mechanisms, and dependencies must be reused wherever possible. |

The detail view must display available event information, such as timestamp, responsible user when available, module, action, safe description, and associated record identifier when available.<br>4. When a persisted appointment cancellation event records the cause `AdditionalAvailabilityDeactivated`, the detail view must explain that the appointment was cancelled because the doctor’s additional availability was deactivated. It must show the appointment reference and the patient’s name when available and necessary to identify the affected appointment.<br>5. The responsible administrator must be identified using the safe information available in the audit record. The system must not invent an administrator name or expose their email when only an identifier is available.<br>6. The system must not expose passwords, tokens, credentials, clinical history, or unnecessary personal information. Patient information may be shown only when needed for the cancellation detail described above.<br>7. Before-and-after values and cancellation causes must be displayed only when they exist in the persisted audit record and are safe to disclose. Free-text reasons or unknown fields must not be exposed unless separately approved and validated.<br>8. Missing or inaccessible events must return an appropriate response without exposing stack traces or sensitive implementation details.<br>9. The detail view must respect the same authorization rules as the audit list.<br>10. The interface must display information in Spanish and follow the existing SaludVital design system.<br>11. The detail view must be usable on desktop, tablet, and mobile screens and support keyboard navigation.<br>12. Existing audit models, services, and relationships must be reused wherever possible. |

### US-ADM-28 — Record Relevant System Activity

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-ADM-28                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Name**                | Record Relevant System Activity                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Description**         | As a system administrator, I want relevant administrative and operational actions to be recorded consistently so that SaludVital maintains a reliable audit trail for authorized review.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. The implementation must first inspect the existing audit mechanism and identify which relevant operations are already recorded.<br>2. Existing audit records and mechanisms must be reused rather than creating a duplicate audit system.<br>3. Relevant administrative actions must be recorded according to the project's existing audit requirements, including the responsible user when available, timestamp, module, action, and associated record identifier when supported.<br>4. The system must not claim that an action was audited unless the audit record was successfully persisted.<br>5. Audit events must not contain passwords, authentication tokens, credentials, clinical history, or unnecessary personal information.<br>6. Audit event descriptions must be clear and consistent with the existing data model.<br>7. The system must preserve the integrity of audit records and must not allow ordinary administrative actions to silently rewrite or delete historical events.<br>8. Audit failures must be handled according to the existing application's reliability and transaction rules; the implementation must not silently conceal failures when doing so would violate an established audit requirement.<br>9. The implementation must not create duplicate audit events for the same operation.<br>10. Relevant automated tests must verify event creation, responsible-user attribution when available, sensitive-data exclusion, and applicable failure behavior.<br>11. Existing modules must be changed only where necessary to meet the approved audit requirements.<br>12. Existing models, services, middleware, and dependencies must be reused wherever possible. Schema or dependency changes require a demonstrated technical need. |

### US-ADM-29 — Cancel Appointments When Deactivating Additional Availability

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-ADM-29                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Name**                | Cancel Appointments When Deactivating Additional Availability                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to review confirmed appointments affected by deactivating an additional availability period and explicitly confirm their cancellation, so that no appointments remain scheduled during a time slot the physician will no longer offer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can deactivate availability exceptions.<br>2. Before deactivating an active `AdditionalAvailability` exception that overlaps with future confirmed appointments, the system must display the affected appointments and explain that confirming the operation will cancel them and queue their notifications.<br>3. The availability exception and appointments must remain unchanged until the administrator explicitly confirms the operation.<br>4. Upon confirmation, the backend must recalculate the affected appointments and cancel only those previously reviewed by the administrator. If the list has changed, the system must display the updated list and request confirmation again.<br>5. The cancellation process must reuse the existing workflow for recording appointment history and audit events, canceling pending reminders, and queuing the existing patient notification.<br>6. Deactivating an `Unavailable` exception or reactivating an exception must not cancel appointments.<br>7. Creating or editing availability exceptions must preserve the current review of affected appointments without canceling them.<br>8. Deactivation and appointment cancellations must be transactional. If the operation fails, the availability exception must remain active and the appointments must remain unchanged.<br>9. Confirmation, success, and error messages must be displayed in Spanish and indicate whether notifications were successfully queued.<br>10. Existing appointment, audit, and notification models and mechanisms must be reused.<br>11. Tests must cover confirmation, changes to the list of affected appointments, cancellations, notifications, and rollback behavior when failures occur. |
| **Mockups**             | N/A — backend appointment cancellation behavior supporting the SaludVital administrative interface.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

# US-ADM-30 — View Administrator Profile

| Field                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| **Name**                | View Administrator Profile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to view my profile information in one place so that I can review my personal details, account status, role, and access information in SaludVital.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only an authenticated administrator can access the administrator profile.<br>2. The profile must load the account associated with the authenticated user; changing a submitted identifier must not allow access to another user’s profile.<br>3. The page must display the persisted administrator name and email, assigned role, and account status.<br>4. If no administrator name is persisted, the page must show a clear fallback and must not invent a name.<br>5. The page must display the administrator’s profile photo when one exists; otherwise, it must use the existing default avatar or initials.<br>6. The page must display available persisted account information, including registration date and last access. Missing values must not be fabricated.<br>7. Personal Information, Security, and Preferences sections must be accessible from the profile. Their editing or management behavior is defined by their respective user stories.<br>8. The profile must not expose passwords, password hashes, authentication or verification tokens, or unnecessary internal account data.<br>9. The page must use Spanish text, follow the supplied SaludVital profile design, and support responsive and keyboard-accessible use.<br>10. The page must use persisted application data, not sample or hardcoded profile data.<br>11. Reuse existing models, services, routes, and authorization middleware. Any schema or dependency change must have a demonstrated need. |

The server must identify the account using the authenticated session and must not accept a client-supplied user ID to select the account being changed.<br>4. The administrator must not be able to update role, account status, internal identifiers, registration date, or other system-managed fields.<br>5. The backend must validate submitted values and enforce email uniqueness.<br>6. Successful changes must be reflected in the profile and recorded through the existing audit system without logging unnecessary personal information or secrets.<br>9. Updates and their audit events must follow applicable transaction rules. The interface must not report an audited success if audit persistence fails.<br>10. A save that makes no changes must not produce a duplicate audit event.<br>11. The editor must be responsive and keyboard accessible.<br>12. Reuse existing validation, models, services, and dependencies; justify any schema changes. |

# US-ADM-32 — Manage Administrator Account Security

| Field                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to review my account’s security status and use the supported password-recovery option so that I can maintain or recover secure access to SaludVital.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only an authenticated administrator can access the Security section of their profile.<br>2. The profile must provide an accessible Security section consistent with the SaludVital design and existing profile architecture.<br>3. The section must display whether the administrator’s email is verified.<br>4. For a verified email, the section must provide access to the existing email-based password-recovery workflow.<br>5. If the email is not verified, the section must explain in Spanish that email verification is required for the available recovery workflow and must not offer unsupported actions.<br>6. Administrator password resets must be recorded through the existing audit mechanism and follow the applicable transaction behavior.<br>7. Audit records must not include passwords, password hashes, recovery tokens, or submitted secret values.<br>8. The existing password hashing, one-time recovery-token validation, session revocation, and sign-out behavior must be preserved.<br>9. The profile must not expose credentials, authentication tokens, verification tokens, or other secrets.<br>10. The Security section must be responsive and keyboard accessible.<br>11. Do not add an authenticated-session password-change flow, multi-factor authentication, or other security features that the application does not support. |

| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to upload, replace, or remove my profile photo using the camera icon on my avatar so that I can personalize my account without adding duplicate photo controls to the profile page.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

The profile photo must appear as a circular avatar in the profile header, consistent with the supplied mockup.<br>3. The camera icon over the avatar must be the only entry point for photo management.<br>4. Activating the camera icon must open an accessible photo-management dialog with upload or change, remove when a photo exists, and cancel or close actions.<br>5. Do not add a separate photo section or duplicate upload and removal buttons elsewhere on the page.<br>6. File selection and preview must be accessible. Reuse the existing upload infrastructure.<br>7. The frontend and backend must validate the file format and size. Supported formats are JPG, PNG, and WEBP, up to 2 MB.<br>8. The administrator must explicitly confirm photo removal.<br>9. If validation, upload, storage, database persistence, or audit persistence fails, the current photo must remain intact.<br>10. The displayed avatar must update only after a successful server response. After removal, show the existing default avatar or initials.<br>11. The self-service endpoints must not allow an administrator to change another user’s photo.<br>12. Show understandable Spanish errors without exposing filesystem paths or stack traces.<br>13. The flow must be responsive and keyboard accessible.<br>14. Reuse existing photo storage, validation, models, routes, and dependencies wherever possible. |

The interface must display success and error feedback in Spanish and preserve the selected value if saving fails.<br>10. The control must be responsive and keyboard accessible.<br>11. Reuse the existing user model, dashboard notification records, audit mechanism, and authorization middleware. A schema change is justified only when no suitable persisted preference field exists. |

# US-ADM-38 — Analyze Appointment Distribution and Trends

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-ADM-38                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Name**                | Analyze Appointment Distribution and Trends                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to visualize appointment distribution by status and specialty, together with appointment trends over time, so that I can identify operational patterns in SaludVital.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access appointment analytics.<br>2. The appointment status chart must show Confirmed, Cancelled, and Rescheduled appointments only.<br>3. Pending, In Progress, and Attended appointments must not appear in the status chart, its legend, or its percentages.<br>4. Rescheduled is an appointment-history event, not a persisted appointment status. For the chart, count distinct appointments in the selected appointment-date range that are currently Confirmed and have at least one persisted Rescheduled history event. Subtract those appointments from Confirmed so each appointment appears in one category only.<br>5. Status-chart percentages must use the sum of Confirmed, Cancelled, and Rescheduled chart counts as their denominator.<br>6. The specialty chart must group persisted appointments by their existing specialty relationship. Appointments without a valid specialty must be handled consistently without causing errors or fabricated data.<br>7. The trend chart must show Attended, Confirmed, and Cancelled appointments as separate series, grouped by appointment start date.<br>8. The visible Spanish label for the persisted `Attended` status must be **Atendidas**.<br>9. Charts, labels, legends, tooltips, totals, and percentages must agree with backend results.<br>10. Charts must show appropriate empty states when there are no matching records.<br>11. All appointment charts must use the period selected in US-ADM-37 and the application’s `America/Bogota` date boundaries.<br>12. Charts must remain readable and responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop without horizontal overflow.<br>13. Reuse existing appointment statuses and relationships. Do not create a status solely for reporting. |

# US-ADM-40 — View Operational Performance Indicators

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-ADM-40                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Name**                | View Operational Performance Indicators                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to review consultation duration, appointment cancellation rate, and WhatsApp appointment requests so that I can evaluate SaludVital’s operational performance.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access the operational indicators.<br>2. The indicator summary must display average consultation duration, cancellation rate, and WhatsApp appointment requests using persisted data and the selected period.<br>3. Calculate average consultation duration as the arithmetic mean of persisted `duration_seconds` for `Completed` consultations with a recorded duration and an `ended_at` timestamp within the selected period. Show **Sin datos** when no qualifying consultation exists.<br>4. Calculate cancellation rate as `cancelled appointments / appointments in Confirmed, In Progress, Attended, or Cancelled status × 100`, using each appointment’s `start_at` within the selected period. Show **Sin datos** when the denominator is zero.<br>5. Count persisted WhatsApp appointment-request records by `created_at` within the selected period. Count each request once, including requests later rejected, cancelled, or expired. A count of zero must be displayed as zero.<br>6. The selected period must be one of the 7-, 30-, or 90-day ranges from US-ADM-37 and must use inclusive `America/Bogota` calendar-day boundaries.<br>7. Do not display a new-patients indicator.<br>8. Format durations, percentages, dates, labels, and unavailable states clearly in Spanish.<br>9. Do not use mock data, hardcoded values, or unsupported assumptions. Show an appropriate unavailable state when the required data is missing.<br>10. The backend must return only data needed by the interface and preserve administrator authorization.<br>11. Reuse existing models, services, and dependencies. Schema or dependency changes require a demonstrated technical need.<br>12. The indicators must follow the supplied reference and remain usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop without horizontal overflow. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied Reports and Indicators dashboard reference image.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to monitor WhatsApp messages and their delivery statuses so that I can identify communication failures and evaluate the reliability of automated notifications.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access message monitoring and its protected endpoints.<br>2. The page retrieves message records from the existing WhatsApp message storage or supported provider integration.<br>3. Summary indicators display available message counts, such as sent, delivered, read, and failed, only when the underlying data supports those states.<br>4. The system must not invent delivery confirmations or infer that a message was delivered merely because a send operation succeeded.<br>5. The message list displays relevant information such as message type, creation date, direction, recipient identification, and delivery status when available.<br>6. Recipient phone numbers and other personal identifiers are masked or minimized in summary views.<br>7. Administrators can filter messages by supported statuses and date ranges.<br>8. The list supports pagination or another bounded retrieval mechanism.<br>9. Message statuses are based on persisted events or reliable provider responses.<br>10. Provider-specific states are mapped to understandable Spanish labels without changing their underlying meaning.<br>11. Failed messages display available non-sensitive diagnostic information when the existing integration supports it.<br>12. Error details must not expose credentials, tokens, message authentication data, or unnecessary patient information.<br>13. The system distinguishes between application-level processing, provider acceptance, delivery confirmation, and read confirmation when these states are supported.<br>14. Historical message records are not modified simply by opening the monitoring page.<br>15. This story does not send, resend, edit, or delete messages.<br>16. Loading, empty, unavailable, and error states are handled clearly.<br>17. The interface follows the supplied message monitoring mockup and SaludVital's existing administrative design.<br>18. The layout is responsive and accessible on mobile phones, tablets, laptops, and desktops.<br>19. Existing message models, notification services, webhook processing, and provider integrations are reused.<br>20. Automated tests cover authorization, supported status calculations, filtering, pagination, missing delivery data, and sensitive information exclusion. |

| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to view and manage supported chatbot conversation flows so that I can understand and maintain the automated interactions available to patients.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
