The interface displays the actual available flows rather than hard-coded examples presented as real configurations.<br>4. Each flow displays its name, description, operational status, and relevant metadata when those fields are supported.<br>5. Administrators can inspect a flow's steps and transitions when the existing implementation exposes them.<br>6. The interface clearly distinguishes read-only flow definitions from flows that can be edited.<br>7. Creating, editing, activating, or deactivating flows is available only when supported by the existing architecture and explicitly approved for implementation.<br>8. Any implemented editing operation validates required fields, supported actions, transitions, and references on the backend.<br>9. Invalid flow configurations cannot be saved or activated.<br>10. Flow updates must not leave the chatbot in a partially configured or inconsistent state.<br>11. Existing active conversations must not be silently corrupted by configuration changes.<br>12. The application must not execute a flow merely because an administrator opens its details.<br>13. The interface provides clear validation, loading, empty, unavailable, and error states.<br>14. Flow names, steps, questions, and responses are displayed safely without executing untrusted content.<br>15. All user-facing labels and messages appear in Spanish.<br>16. The design follows the supplied chatbot flow mockup and existing SaludVital administrative components.<br>17. The interface is responsive on mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop screens.<br>18. Keyboard navigation and accessible controls are supported.<br>19. New flow tables, visual editors, or dependencies must not be introduced without demonstrating the need and obtaining approval for architectural changes.<br>20. Automated tests cover authorization, flow retrieval, configuration validation, and any implemented editing operations. |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

compliant with the messaging provider's requirements. The interface displays the actual available templates without presenting fabricated templates as configured resources.<br>4. Each template displays its name, purpose, supported category, content, language, and status when those fields are available.<br>5. Administrators can search and filter templates using supported fields.<br>6. The interface distinguishes application-defined templates from templates registered with the WhatsApp provider.<br>7. Provider approval statuses are displayed only when supported by reliable integration data.<br>8. A locally saved template must not be represented as provider-approved unless that approval is confirmed.<br>9. Creating or editing templates is supported only when the existing architecture and provider integration allow those operations.<br>10. Backend validation checks required fields, supported formats, template variables, and applicable content constraints for implemented editing operations.<br>11. Template variables must be validated to prevent invalid references or incomplete message definitions.<br>12. Template content must be rendered safely without executing untrusted markup or scripts.<br>13. Template modifications must not alter previously sent messages or historical conversation records.<br>14. Provider submission and approval workflows must not be simulated.<br>15. Administrators receive understandable Spanish feedback for successful operations, validation failures, and provider errors.<br>16. Credentials, access tokens, and provider secrets are never exposed.<br>17. Loading, empty, unavailable, and error states are handled clearly.<br>18. The interface follows the supplied message template mockup and existing SaludVital visual conventions.<br>19. The layout is responsive and accessible across mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop screens.<br>20. # Notification Management — User Stories

## US-ADM-47 — View Notification Dashboard and Summary Metrics

| **Identifier**          | **US-ADM-47**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Notification Dashboard and Summary Metrics                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to view notification statistics and a notification management dashboard so that I can monitor the overall delivery performance of SaludVital's communication channels.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access the notification dashboard and protected endpoints.<br>2. The page must display the title "Notificaciones" and the description "Gestiona y consulta el historial de notificaciones enviadas desde el sistema".<br>3. The dashboard must follow the supplied desktop and mobile mockup.<br>4. Four summary cards must display the supported counts for "Total enviadas", "Entregadas", "Fallidas", and "Pendientes".<br>5. Metrics must be calculated from real database records and supported provider information.<br>6. Each metric must have clearly defined counting rules to prevent duplicated or contradictory values.<br>7. Percentages and historical comparisons must be displayed only when reliable comparison data is available.<br>8. Notification metrics must distinguish between application processing status and confirmed provider delivery status.<br>9. The dashboard must support WhatsApp Cloud API, Resend, Inalambria Express, and internal system notifications according to the current architecture.<br>10. The page must include the visual structure for channel tabs, search filters, notification history, and configuration access, without prematurely implementing other user stories.<br>11. Loading, empty, unavailable, and error states must be handled.<br>12. All interface labels must appear in Spanish.<br>13. The page must be responsive on mobile phones, tablets, laptops, and desktops without horizontal overflow.<br>14. Navigation and interactive controls must support keyboard accessibility.<br>15. Automated tests must cover authorization, metric calculations, empty data, and errors. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied notification management desktop and mobile mockup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/DeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## US-ADM-48 — View Notification History

| **Identifier**          | **US-ADM-48**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | View Notification History                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to view a paginated history of notifications generated by SaludVital so that I can monitor communications sent to patients and identify their processing and delivery statuses.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access the notification history and its protected endpoints.<br>2. The history must retrieve real persisted notification records using existing models and services.<br>3. The table must display the supported columns: "Fecha", "Canal", "Destinatario", "Tipo", "Mensaje", "Estado", and "Acciones".<br>4. The channel must accurately identify WhatsApp, email, SMS, or an internal system notification.<br>5. Each record must show the date and time, notification type, recipient information when authorized, a safe limited message preview, and the actual persisted status.<br>6. Personal information must be minimized or masked where appropriate. Sensitive clinical information must not be displayed unnecessarily.<br>7. Sending a message to a provider must not automatically be represented as confirmed delivery.<br>8. The notification list must be ordered by date, newest first by default.<br>9. Implement server-side pagination with bounded queries. Use the existing pagination conventions when available.<br>10. Pagination controls must accurately display the current page and available results.<br>11. The responsive mobile layout must display notification records as compact cards instead of forcing a desktop table into a small viewport.<br>12. The interface must match the supplied SaludVital notification mockup.<br>13. Empty, loading, unavailable, and error states must be handled.<br>14. Message previews must be rendered safely and must not execute untrusted markup.<br>15. Do not add delete, resend, or status-changing operations under this story.<br>16. Automated tests must cover authorization, database retrieval, ordering, pagination, field mapping, and privacy. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied notification management desktop and mobile mockup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/DeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## US-ADM-49 — Search and Filter Notifications

| **Identifier**          | **US-ADM-49**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Name**                | Search and Filter Notifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to search and filter notifications by communication channel, delivery status, and date range so that I can find relevant communication records efficiently.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can search and filter notification records.<br>2. The interface must provide the tabs "Todas", "Correo electrónico", "WhatsApp", "SMS", and "Sistema".<br>3. Each tab must filter notifications by their real persisted channel.<br>4. The interface must include a search field for supported recipient identifiers, notification subjects, and message information where safe and available.<br>5. Searching must not expose additional personal or clinical information.<br>6. Administrators can filter notifications by supported delivery or processing statuses.<br>7. Administrators can filter notifications by date range, including the reference period "Últimos 30 días" when supported.<br>8. The system must validate search parameters, date ranges, status values, and pagination on the server.<br>9. Search criteria and filters can be combined.<br>10. Changing search criteria must reset pagination appropriately.<br>11. Pagination must preserve the active filters.<br>12. The results and any displayed record counts must match the applied filters.<br>13. Channel and status options must reflect actual data capabilities and must not invent unsupported states.<br>14. Filters must work correctly with empty datasets.<br>15. Search input and query handling must prevent SQL injection and unsafe output rendering.<br>16. The selected tab, search text, and filter states must remain visually clear.<br>17. The design must match the supplied desktop and mobile notification mockup.<br>18. On small screens, filters must remain usable without horizontal overflow.<br>19. Search, tabs, and filter controls must support keyboard navigation and appropriate accessible labels.<br>20. Automated tests must cover filtering, search combinations, invalid parameters, pagination preservation, authorization, and empty results. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied notification management desktop and mobile mockup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## US-ADM-50 — View Notification Details and Delivery Events

| **Identifier**          | **US-ADM-50** |
| **Name**                | View Notification Details and Delivery Events                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to inspect notification details and available delivery events so that I can understand how an individual notification was processed and investigate communication failures.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access notification details and their protected endpoints.<br>2. The notification list must provide an accessible actions menu or detail control.<br>3. Selecting "Ver detalles" must open a responsive modal, panel, or detail page consistent with the existing SaludVital architecture.<br>4. The detail view must display available information such as notification type, channel, creation date, recipient identification, processing status, provider reference, and relevant delivery timestamps.<br>5. The original event that generated the notification must be displayed when a supported, authorized reference exists.<br>6. The interface must distinguish between application processing events, provider acceptance, actual delivery, read confirmation, and failures whenever the underlying data supports those states.<br>7. Delivery events must be presented chronologically when they exist.<br>8. Failure reasons must be based on persisted data or reliable provider responses.<br>9. When delivery information is missing, the interface must display an understandable unavailable or unknown state.<br>10. Never infer delivered or read status from a successful send operation alone.<br>11. Sensitive tokens, provider credentials, unnecessary personal information, and clinical details must not be exposed.<br>12. Notification identifiers and requested detail records must be validated on the backend.<br>13. Records that do not exist or cannot be accessed must produce appropriate responses without leaking information.<br>14. This story must remain read-only and must not send, resend, delete, or modify notifications.<br>15. The detail interface must work on desktop, tablet, and mobile.<br>16. Modals and action menus must support accessible focus handling, keyboard interaction, and appropriate dismissal.<br>17. All visible interface text and errors must be in Spanish.<br>18. Automated tests must cover authorization, valid and invalid identifiers, event retrieval, missing provider data, safe error handling, and sensitive information protection. |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated administrator, I want to review and manage supported operational notification settings so that I can understand and maintain the notification system without modifying individual patient preferences or duplicating provider configuration.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated administrators can access notification settings.<br>2. The notification dashboard provides a "Configuración de notificaciones" button.<br>3. The button opens a responsive settings page or panel following existing SaludVital design conventions.<br>4. The settings interface displays the currently supported notification configuration from existing services or persisted records.<br>5. The interface clearly identifies available notification channels: WhatsApp, email, and SMS, when supported by the current integration.<br>6. Each channel's operational status must reflect reliable data from its provider or backend configuration.<br>7. The interface must not claim that a channel is connected solely because credentials exist.<br>8. Administrative settings must not override the patient's individual notification channel preferences.<br>9. At least one patient-selected notification channel must remain enabled. A channel may be described as verified or available only when the existing integration or persisted account data provides a reliable signal; an enabled preference or configured provider must not be treated as verification. If a verification signal is unsupported, show that status as unavailable and do not block channel selection solely because verification cannot be determined.<br>10. Changes to operational settings must be supported by the current architecture and validated on the backend.<br>11. If a setting is read-only or unsupported, the interface must clearly indicate that it cannot be edited.<br>12. Provider API keys, webhook secrets, phone-number identifiers, and other credentials must not be exposed in this interface.<br>13. Configuration of Resend, WhatsApp Cloud API, and Inalambria Express must remain in the existing provider integration module rather than being duplicated here.<br>14. Do not introduce additional complex notification rules, scheduling engines, or chatbot settings under this story.<br>15. Changes must not silently modify historical notification records.<br>16. The interface must handle unavailable configurations, validation failures, and errors safely.<br>17. All visible interface text must be in Spanish.<br>18. The design must be responsive, accessible, and consistent with the supplied notification mockup.<br>19. Existing notification services, configuration mechanisms, and shared components must be reused.<br>20. Automated tests must cover authorization, configuration retrieval, validation, patient preference preservation, and sensitive information protection. |
| **Mockups**             | Supplied notification management desktop and mobile mockup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/DeltaG8109)
