# US-DOC-15 — View Doctor Appointment Notifications

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-DOC-15                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Name**                | View Doctor Appointment Notifications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Description**         | As an authenticated doctor, I want to see appointment changes relevant to my assigned appointments and track which updates I have read so that I can keep my schedule current.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only authenticated doctors can access their notification feed and unread count.<br>2. The feed is derived from persisted appointment history events and existing appointment assignments; it does not use fabricated notifications.<br>3. The feed includes only appointment creation, rescheduling, and cancellation events for appointments currently assigned to the authenticated doctor.<br>4. Each item shows a concise Spanish event label, appointment date and time when available, and event timestamp. It does not expose clinical notes, appointment reasons, patient contact details, credentials, or unrelated patient data.<br>5. The feed is ordered newest first with bounded server-side pagination.<br>6. Unread state is stored per doctor and per appointment history event. Reading an event does not modify appointment history or patient notification records.<br>7. Selecting a notification opens an accessible detail dialog with its persisted event type and available timestamps; untrusted content is rendered as text.<br>8. The doctor can mark one notification or all currently unread notifications as read. Repeated read requests are idempotent, and the unread count is refreshed after either operation.<br>9. Data access derives the doctor from the authenticated session and never accepts a client-provided doctor ID.<br>10. Invalid identifiers, unauthorized access, unavailable data, and database errors are handled safely.<br>11. The doctor top-bar bell links to the protected feed and displays the real unread count.<br>12. The responsive interface and controls are in Spanish and keyboard accessible.<br>13. New persistence is additive and reversible; no existing appointment, notification, or patient preference data is deleted or altered.<br>14. Automated tests cover doctor authorization, event selection, assignment scoping, ordering, pagination, unread counts, individual and bulk read updates, details, and privacy. |
| **Mockups**             | Existing doctor dashboard notification bell; no separate mockup supplied.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

Implementation details: [US-DOC-15](implementation/US-DOC-15-view-doctor-appointment-notifications.md). GitHub Issue: [#258](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109/saludvital/issues/258).

## US-ADM-52 — Automatically Mark Missed Appointments

| **Field**               | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Identifier**          | US-ADM-52                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Name**                | Automatically Mark Missed Appointments                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **User Story**          | As an administrator, I want confirmed appointments that remain unattended to be marked as no-show after a one-hour grace period so that appointment records reflect missed visits accurately.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | 1. Only appointments still persisted as Confirmed are eligible for automatic no-show processing.<br>2. An appointment becomes No Show only when its persisted start time is at least one hour in the past; comparisons use stored instants and application date handling remains consistent with America/Bogota.<br>3. Cancelled, attended, in-progress, and any other non-confirmed appointments are excluded.<br>4. Processing is bounded, idempotent, concurrency-safe, and recovers eligible appointments after application downtime without duplicate history events.<br>5. Each successful transition updates the persisted appointment and records the transition in existing appointment history and audit mechanisms.<br>6. Relevant appointment lists, filters, dashboards, exports, reports, and history display the Spanish label No asistió.<br>7. The automated transition does not send notifications or alter patient communication preferences.<br>8. A doctor may start a consultation for an appointment automatically marked No Show if the patient arrives late. The transition to In Progress must record the previous No Show state in appointment history and audit logs.<br>9. Other consultation ownership, status, and active-consultation rules remain enforced.<br>10. Automated tests cover the grace-period boundary, timezone-equivalent instants, excluded states, idempotency/concurrency safeguards, history/audit writes, late consultation start, and recovery after scheduler downtime.<br>11. The additive status migration has a safe rollback that preserves referenced records.<br>12. User-facing status labels are Spanish; identifiers and technical documentation follow repository conventions. |
| **Author**              | [@DeltaG8109](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

Implementation details: [US-ADM-52](implementation/US-ADM-52-auto-mark-no-show-appointments.md). GitHub Issue: [#311](https://github.com/personalProjectsDeltaG8109/saludvital/issues/311).
